verdict.rationale: Blocking sender tracking pixels and being transparent about mail-data use is a fair question for any email client, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack documents tracking-pixel blocking, image proxying, remote-image controls, or a disclosure of how Gmail handles mail data. The cited items cover only API scopes, add-ons, AI features and other unrelated capabilities.

support.subject: As a switcher, the client protects me from senders' tracking — blocking read pixels by default — and is transparent about what it does with my mail data
